threads.body: Tuple content containing dictionaries, such as `({"text": "Hello"},)`, now enters this branch but yields no text: `getattr(item, "text", None)` cannot read dictionary keys. Thus `{"role": "user", "content": ({"text": "Hello"},)}` is omitted from input telemetry. Read each item's text with `_field_value`, which already supports both SDK objects and the dictionary shape included in `QwenContentItem`. Add a raw-dictionary tuple-content regression case.

threads.body: The signatures now accept `Sequence`, but all five runtime guards still recognize only lists and tuples. For example, `UserList([{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}])` loses its input text; assistant histories similarly produce empty or missing output. `find_tool_call_id` rejects these histories, and `_extract_content_text` stringifies general sequences instead of joining their text. Use `Sequence` consistently in all five helpers, preserving scalar string/bytes handling, and add `UserList` regression cases to cover the contract requested in #904.

Applied _is_sequence across _extract_content_text, find_tool_call_id, convert_to_input_messages, convert_to_output_messages, and convert_to_final_output_messages. Added regression tests test_conversion_helpers_handle_user_list_sequences and test_agent_run_with_user_list_messages using collections.UserList.
